BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gᵉlôwm means wrapping, garment. It occurs just once, in Ezekiel.
TheologicalSignificance: I take gᵉlôwm as it stands — wrapping, garment — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
